# Copilot Instructions

- Always read [ARCHITECTURE.md](../ARCHITECTURE.md) for project context before making changes.
- After making edits, check that no typescript errors are present.
- After making edits, run `npm test` to verify them.
- After functional (user-facing) changes, update the user docs in `docs/`.
- After implementation, architecture, library, or refactoring changes, update the developer docs in `docs/developer/`.
